simple.meaning: אָצִיל (ʼâtsîyl) is a Hebrew word meaning “an extremity (Isaiah 41:9), also a noble.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אָצִיל (H678) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 24:11, with occurrences in Exodus, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָצִיל (H678) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אָצִיל (H678) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אָצִיל (ʼâtsîyl) / H678 is traced through Exodus 24:11, Isaiah 41:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H678. atsil אָצִיל noun [masculine] side, corner, chief — plural construct אֲצִילֵי Exod 24:11 ; suffix אֲצִילֶיהָ Isa 41:9 ; — 1 sides (borders) of earth Isa 41:9 (|| קצות ); compare א ׳ירכתי Jer 6:22 etc. 2 figurative nobles (perhaps as sides, supports , compare below מִּנּוֺת ; so Ew Di but perhaps = noble — from be rooted , root , metaphor origin, stock — properly a man having a (known) origin, sprung from an ancient and famous stock; so Ges, compare Lag BN 68 ) Exod 24:11 .
definitions.rootNote: from 680 (in its secondary sense of separation );
